# Missouri and Illinois still allow paraquat weed killer\. An Iowa man with Parkinson’s wants it banned Art Staed first noticed trouble with his fine motor skills two years ago\. He had difficulty using a keyboard and writing his name\. People noticed his facial expressions had changed\. His balance was off\. Staed, an Iowa state senator who has lived in Kansas and Missouri, announced last year he had been diagnosed with Parkinson’s disease, the fastest-growing neurodegenerative disease in the world\. # ADM Names Jeff Rowe Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer July 20, 2026 – ADM has appointed agriculture industry veteran Jeff Rowe as its new Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer, effective August 17\. The newly created position is designed to strengthen the company’s leadership team as ADM continues to advance its long-term growth strategy\. Rowe will oversee ADM’s commercial businesses, global manufacturing operations and research and development efforts\. He will report directly to Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Juan Luciano\. Rowe joins ADM from Syngenta Group, where he has served as chief executive officer since 2024 after holding several senior leadership positions with the global agriculture company\. Before joining Syngenta in 2016, he spent more than two decades with DuPont Pioneer in executive roles focused on strategy, international operations, biotechnology and regulatory affairs\.
